summary: version-poller classifies every tag by the tracking-tag label (DockerImages 1a69ff9 on phase/031-P5): tracking = named as its label, history = in the label's series (tagging.build_number mirrors cleanup's), other labelled = promoted copy (only the newest per label warned when stale), unlabelled ignored, self-labelled bare numbers are leftovers; the regex, is_versioned and the label fallback are gone, 78 tests green, gate green. A live dry run of the new and old code, with the clock set to each daily poll from 09-30 to 10-08, triggers identical pipelines and params; the per-day list is in the done-record.
